extraction_notes: The supplied datasheet is for BC847BS, a dual NPN small signal transistor; the package is SOT-363.
Electrical characteristics are specified at TA = 25 degC unless otherwise specified.
Maximum ratings transcribed from p. 1: VCBO = 50 V, VCEO = 45 V, VEBO = 6 V, continuous IC = 100 mA, PD = 200 mW, RthetaJA = 625 degC/W, and TJ/TSTG = -55 to +150 degC.
The p. 1 electrical table gives ICBO maximum 15 nA at VCB = 30 V and IE = 0, and IEBO maximum 15 nA at VEB = 4 V and IC = 0.
The p. 1 base-emitter voltage table gives VBE(1) minimum 0.58 V and maximum 0.70 V at VCE = 5 V and IC = 2 mA, plus typical VBE(2) = 0.77 V at VCE = 5 V and IC = 10 mA.
The p. 1 switching table gives storage time maximum 200 ns at IC = 10 mA with IB1 = IB2 = 1 mA.

The p. 2 typical-characteristics page contains curves at -40 degC, 25 degC, and 125 degC. The curves recorded here are the 25 degC traces digitized directly from the supplied figures; curve points are approximate readings, not interpolated values.
The p. 2 capacitance figure shows both input and output capacitance, but no exact Cibo electrical-characteristics table row is supplied, so specs.cibo is null.
No output-characteristics IC-versus-VCE figure or Early-voltage datum is supplied; no Early-voltage curve was extracted.
